sections.title: Doctoral Seminar in Epidemiology
sections.description: The course is intended to meet the needs of PhD students over the entire program from the coursework phase through the dissertation defense, and is intended to optimize cross-fertilization between the students at all phases of their program. Restricted to Epidemiology Doctoral Students. Prerequisite: Permission of instructor.
